body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: c6c658db94ac0757546157e1bab0711af44eb6d1 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (independent review at the high tier: rapid-in-stock law).

**What looks good**
- The fix is at the right place. `Rest::in_stock` (crates/sim/src/verify/rest.rs:178) falls back to `cx.region` when `VerifyContext::stock` is `None`, and for a stock-sourced Bore/Thread that region has the rims punched out. `judged_stock` (material_source.rs, end of file) hands verify the stock's own facets for exactly `SrcRef::Stock` with `Bore`/`Thread`; every other source/kind returns `stock_facets` unchanged, so their reading is byte for byte as before.
- Can it under-read? No. `stock` only widens `in_stock` (hole column now counts as material). Every consumer I traced (rapids.rs:116/143, hidden.rs:111/128, reach.rs:59/81/166, rapids_radial.rs) uses it as a gate that adds candidates, so the change can add convictions but never remove one. `surface_before` and `stock_top_z` (max of material top and stock AABB) are untouched, so the height read is the same.
- The shadowed `judged_stock` feeds only the two verify contexts (generate.rs upright ~L160/2737 and 3+2 ~L3049/3057). The other `stock_facets` consumers (turning, plunge_solid, meridian, air_law, drill reach) still read the original, so no blast radius beyond the law.
- `acquit_by_prior` still clears a face-ahead case (pinned by test 4). No generator/path change, no golden moved.
- Decision file present, the PR body is complete, and the 4 tests each run Pocket, Bore and Contour with positive and silent controls.

**Local results** (trial merge with upstream/main: already up to date; tool: sccache, own target/)
| step | result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (45 app suites + lib) | ok, 120 s |
| ladder_entry_height | 4 passed |
| arc_entry 3, conformance 6, golden_cl 25, level_links 7, mill2d_b 9, mill2d_c 9, operations 117 (6 ignored), refusal_location 3, vertical_arc_entry 3 | all pass |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

No build.rs, .github, scripts or dependency changes; no process files touched (no PROCESS_VERSION bump needed); no snapshot PNGs; CHANGELOG untouched; no unwrap/expect/indexing added (`&material.facets[..]` is a full-range slice).

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. The 3+2 (frame) arm (generate.rs ~L3049) takes the same stock but has no `acquit_by_prior` call, unlike the upright arm (~L2836). A tilted stock-sourced Bore (or Thread) after a facing op that cleared the column now gets `RapidInStock` with no acquittal. That is the same behaviour tilted Pocket/Contour already have, and it errs on the safe side (a refusal, not a gouge), but it is a new refusal for tilted Bore. Worth a follow-up issue plus a tilted pin; the PR already says tilted was not exercised.
2. Thread has no pin of its own (the PR says so); the shared `matches!` arm covers it.
3. `generate.rs` is far over the ~400-line guideline; this PR adds only 4 lines.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
